description_en: Retrieves the list of on-duty personnel for a shift schedule
description_zh: 获取值班表的值班人员列表
name: ListShiftPersonnels

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the shift schedule
parameters.name: shift_schedule_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The query condition for on-duty personnel. Valid values:
ALL: all on-duty personnel.
PRIMARY: primary on-duty personnel.
BACKUP: backup on-duty personnel.
DESIGNATED_USER: designated personnel
parameters.help_zh: 值班人查询条件：ALL（全部值班人）、PRIMARY（主值班人）、BACKUP（备值班人）、DESIGNATED_USER（指定人）
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner to view the account ID
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云账号ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台，鼠标悬停至顶部菜单栏右侧的用户头像，查看账号ID
parameters.name: shift_person_uid

parameters.help_en: The start time of the on-duty period. This value is a timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 值班人开始时间，时间戳
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the on-duty period. This value is a timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 值班人结束时间，时间戳
parameters.name: end_time
